name: text-outline-draw-fill
title: Outline Stroke Draw
description: Nét viền của từng chữ cái tự vẽ ra nối đuôi nhau, rồi ruột chữ tô đặc dần ngay trước khi nét vẽ xong.

moworks.author: moworks

options.fill: s (0.5, power2.out), starting 0.1 s before the stroke ends

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Per glyph outline: dash draw 0 → full length 1.3 s, cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), from 0.3 s + k × stagger (0.1 s, capped so all start within 0.7 s); stroke 1.6 px accent. Fill opacity 0 → 1 in 0.5 s power2.out from 1.5 s + k × stagger (0.1 s before its stroke ends). A faint 1 px outline of each glyph shows from the start and fades as the fill arrives. Fade all out 3.8–4.2 s. Loop 4.4 s. Recipe values: 2 s draw, 0.5 s fill. Params: thời gian vẽ (1.3 s mỗi chữ) · cách nhau (0.1 s) · tô (0.5 s) · nét (1.6 px).
moworks.titleVi: Nét viền chữ tự vẽ rồi tô đặc
